features.description: For Cook17.17 supply the entire fēower ðūsend manna phrase, four thousand men, with genitive group after the higher numeral.
features.scope_note: Adapted local phrase using checked higher numeral and Cook154c genitive relation; no general higher-numeral production system.

features.description: Nouns naming the same referent in apposition take the same case. In the assigned title/name phrase Dryhtnes Hǣlendes Crīstes all three are genitive singular; appositional God and Fæder retain their nominative role in the blessing.
features.scope_note: Cook151 case agreement, bounded to ordinary title/name and identifying noun apposition. Earlier source-only appositions retain their histories. Existing genitive dependencies and possessive agreement remain separate.
